references.text: The Lord asks how long the people will despise him and not believe in him, despite all the signs he has done among them.
The psalm describes how the people of Israel did not believe in God and did not trust in his salvation.
Despite God's miracles, the people continued to sin and did not believe in his wonderful works.
The people despised the pleasant land and did not believe in the Lord's word.
Warns against having an evil and unbelieving heart that falls away from the living God, a parallel to Israel's unbelief in the wilderness.
Refers directly to those who wandered in the wilderness and were not allowed to enter God's rest because of their unbelief.
Reminds that the Lord delivered the people out of Egypt, but then destroyed those who did not believe.
